description: Source code for PEAR_Command_Install class, implementing PEAR package management commands such as install, upgrade, uninstall, bundle, and run-scripts within the PEAR framework.

classes.name: PEAR_Command_Install
classes.description: Class providing PEAR package management commands such as install, upgrade, uninstall, bundle, and run-scripts.

methods.name: doInstall
methods.description: Handles installation and upgrade of PEAR packages, including dependency resolution and error handling.

methods.name: doUpgradeAll
methods.description: Upgrades all installed PEAR packages to their latest available versions.

methods.name: doUninstall
methods.description: Uninstalls specified PEAR packages, handling dependencies and remote uninstallation.

methods.name: doBundle
methods.description: Downloads and unpacks a PEAR package into a specified directory.

methods.name: doRunScripts
methods.description: Runs post-installation scripts bundled with a PEAR package.

methods.name: _filterUptodatePackages
methods.description: Filters out packages that are already up-to-date to avoid unnecessary upgrades.

methods.name: enableExtension
methods.description: Enables specified PHP extensions by modifying php.ini.

methods.name: disableExtension
methods.description: Disables specified PHP extensions by modifying php.ini.

methods.name: _parseIni
methods.description: Parses php.ini file to extract extension configurations.

methods.name: getDownloader
methods.description: Creates and returns a PEAR_Downloader instance for package downloads.

methods.name: getInstaller
methods.description: Creates and returns a PEAR_Installer instance for package installation.
